effects.title: Basic Attack
effects.description: Danjin melakukan hingga 3 serangan berturut-turut, memberikan  Havoc DMG.

effects.title: Heavy Attack
effects.description: Danjin mengonsumsi STA untuk melancarkan serangan bertubi-tubi, memberikan  Havoc DMG.

effects.title: Mid-air Attack
effects.description: Danjin melakukan hingga 3 serangan berturut-turut, memberikan  Havoc DMG.

effects.title: Dodge Counter
effects.description: Setelah Dodge Counter yang sukses, Danjin dapat menggunakan Resonance Skill: Crimson Fragment untuk melancarkan Resonance Skill: Crimson Erosion.
Setiap kali Crimson Fragment digunakan, mengonsumsi 3% HP maksimum Danjin.
Jika HP Danjin kurang dari 1%, skill ini tidak lagi mengonsumsi HP.

effects.title: Carmine Gleam
effects.description: Danjin menyerang target, memberikan  Havoc DMG.

effects.title: Crimson Erosion
effects.description:
Setelah Basic Attack 2, Dodge Counter, atau Intro Skill: Vindication, gunakan Resonance Skill untuk melakukan hingga 2 serangan berturut-turut, memberikan  Havoc DMG.
Jika Crimson Erosion 2 mengenai target, akan menerapkan efek Incinerating Will.

effects.title: Incinerating Will
effects.description: Danjin memberikan 20% lebih banyak DMG ke target yang memiliki efek Incinerating Will.

effects.title: Sanguine Pulse
effects.description: Gunakan Resonance Skill setelah Basic Attack 3 untuk melancarkan hingga 3 serangan berturut-turut, memberikan  Havoc DMG.
Danjin meluapkan amarahnya dengan mengayunkan dual blade secara cepat, melakukan serangkaian serangan bertubi-tubi dan diakhiri dengan Scarlet Burst, memberikan  Havoc DMG.

effects.title: Heavy Attack: Chaoscleave
effects.description:
Setelah mengumpulkan 60 Ruby Blossom, tahan Basic Attack untuk mengonsumsi semua Ruby Blossom dan melancarkan Chaoscleave, memberikan  Havoc DMG (dihitung sebagai Heavy Attack DMG) serta memulihkan HP Danjin.
Jika Ruby Blossom mencapai lebih dari 120, maka 120 Ruby Blossom dikonsumsi untuk meningkatkan DMG Multiplier dari Chaoscleave dan Scatterbloom yang digunakan kali ini.

effects.title: Heavy Attack: Scatterbloom
effects.description: Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Heavy Attack: Chaoscleave untuk melancarkan Scatterbloom, menyerang target dan memberikan  Havoc DMG (dihitung sebagai Heavy Attack DMG).

effects.title: Ruby Blossom
effects.description:
Danjin bisa menyimpan hingga 120 Ruby Blossom.
Danjin mendapatkan Ruby Blossom setiap kali menggunakan Resonance Skill: Crimson Fragment.
DMG dari Resonance Skill: Crimson Erosion yang dipicu oleh Dodge Counter: Ruby Shades meningkat 20%.
Cost HP berkurang dan jumlah Ruby Blossom yang diperoleh menjadi dua kali lipat.
Setelah menggunakan Resonance Skill: Sanguine Pulse, DMG dari Heavy Attack Danjin meningkat sebesar 30% selama 5 detik.
Dengan tekad yang tak tergoyahkan, Danjin melancarkan serangan, memberikan  Havoc DMG.
Resonator yang masuk mendapatkan 23%  Havoc DMG Amplification selama 14 detik atau hingga mereka digantikan.
Saat Danjin menyerang target yang terkena Incinerating Will dari Resonance Skill, ATK meningkat 5% selama 6 detik, dapat di stack(s) hingga 6 kali.
Danjin akan kehilangan 1 stack setiap kali menerima damage.
Saat Danjin menyerang target yang terkena Incinerating Will dari Resonance Skill, DMG yang diberikan meningkat 20%
Bonus DMG dari Resonance Liberation meningkat sebesar 30%.
Jika Danjin memiliki lebih dari 60 Ruby Blossom, Crit Rate meningkat 15%.
Efek ini bertahan hingga akhir Heavy Attack: Scatterbloom, bahkan setelah semua Ruby Blossom dikonsumsi saat menggunakan Heavy Attack: Chaoscleave.
Havoc DMG Bonus meningkat 15%, dan meningkat lagi 15% jika HP Danjin kurang dari 60%.
Heavy Attack: Chaoscleave meningkatkan ATK seluruh anggota tim sebesar 20% selama 20 detik.

TalentDoc.Title: Resonance Evaluation Report
TalentDoc.Content:
Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 1856-G]

The exact time of Resonator Danjin's Awakening remains uncertain. Notably, during Resonator Danjin's Awakening event, she exhibited an uncontrollable state of emotional outburst. It is speculated that overwhelming emotions may have catalyzed her awakening.

A Tacet Mark is located on Danjin's upper left arm. Observations have revealed distinct alterations in her physical characteristics after her Awakening. A noteworthy alteration is the reddening of her pupils after exerting her Forte to a certain threshold.

Resonator Danjin's frequency fluctuations are stronger than usual, displaying uncommon instantaneous changes that may result in physical damage to her surroundings and any living beings therein when left unattended.

Empirical testing has revealed that Danjin's destructive potential surpasses normal people by 78.94%.
Resonance Spectrum Pattern of this Resonator matches that of the human blood. Tests reveal strong Syntony Responses, yet the cause of Danjin's Awakening remains unclear.


Analysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent Rabelle's Curve with a steep rise in its middle section. Therefore, Danjin is classified as a Mutant Resonator.

TalentCertification.Title: Overclock Diagnostic Report
TalentCertification.Content:
Resonator Danjin's waveform graph shows zigzag fluctuations. The pattern of Time Domain is irregular. Both the upper and lower peak values are high and manifest proximity to the Criticality level. The waveform displays segments of partial fuzziness and abnormal waveform can be seen.

Resonant Criticality: Low, with low stability. Risk of Overclocking remains.

Resonator Danjin has no recorded history of Overclocking. However, during her first Awakening, she was on the verge of reaching her Resonant Criticality. This caused her blood to exhibit an explosive state and a highly sensitive Frequency Fluctuation reaction. Danjin lost control of her behavior, resulting in the spilling of part of her Frequency Energy. No casualties were reported, but the incident was classified as a Class 2 hazard (code EX61453).

Diagnostic analysis reveals that her frequency fluctuation stemmed from a huge provocation in a short time. Noticeable aftereffect persists. As a result, there is still a small chance for Resonator Danjin to enter a state of fury during violent mood swings.

Further assessment reveals that the risk of Overclocking for Danjin is closely linked to her emotional state, posing a high risk. It is recommended to closely monitor her psychological and physical condition, and conduct routine counseling and examinations.
